info.title: DigiBuddy API
info.description: A personal digital twin for emotional wellbeing. Not a medical device; see GET /api/v1/meta.

post.description: Clears the refresh cookie and revokes every token issued to this user.

delete.description: Permanently delete the account, all data, and all trained model files.

get.description: All of your data as JSON, or your check-ins as CSV with ``?format=csv``.

post.description:
Create or replace the check-in for a local date (defaults to today).

Scores the stored forecast for that day, then refreshes tomorrow's forecast with the
active model (no retraining on this path).

schema.title: Response List Checkins Api V1 Checkins Get
Response List Metrics Api V1 Metrics Get

get.description:
Tomorrow's forecast, or progress toward the first one (7 logged days).

Includes a ``support`` object whenever the latest check-in (today or yesterday) or
the forecast calls for it, so the Today page can show it first.
